name: Taiwanese Sweet Potato Balls
steps: Steam peeled sweet potato chunks until tender, about 15 minutes.
Mash smooth while hot and mix in sugar; cool until just warm.
Knead in tapioca starch to a soft dough that holds together. Roll into 2 cm balls; if sticky, dust hands with a little of the measured starch.
Fry in batches at 150–160°C. Once balls float, press them gently under the oil several times with a slotted spoon; fry 5–7 minutes total until hollow, puffed and golden. Drain.
tips: The repeated gentle pressing is what helps these tapioca balls puff into a chewy hollow centre.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
